tools.name: list_tools
tools.description: List Cutshed's free browser tools with the public URL and a one-line description. Studio, checkout, and account actions are not included.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Return one free Cutshed tool by slug, title, or path. Example slug: vocal-remover.

tools.name: get_studio_pricing
tools.description: Return Studio credit packs and model prices from the live catalog. Prices are credits and provider cents. This does not start a purchase or a generation.

tools.name: quote_clipper
tools.description: Return the public clipper quote for an 8-window highlight pass: windows, apiCents, credits, frameApiCents, markup, and vision. Audio-only scoring on the site is free. credits is the vision price when vision is true.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search the public Cutshed guide (llms.txt) and the free-tool list. Returns short matching excerpts. It does not search account data. Account tools are separate and need OAuth.

tools.name: get_my_account
tools.description: Read the signed-in person's email and display name. Requires an OAuth bearer token with profile:read.

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.description: Read the credit balance and recent credit history. Requires an OAuth bearer token with credits:read.

tools.name: start_generation
tools.description: Start a Studio generation with the same pricing, balance check, and per-account limits as the website. Requires OAuth scopes studio:generate and credits:spend.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: Read one Studio generation's status and results for the token's account. Requires OAuth scope studio:generate. Pass the id returned by start_generation.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_my_account" references sensitive artifacts (bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_tools, get_my_account · Private data: get_my_account, get_my_credits, get_generation · Public sink: get_my_account.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_tools, get_my_account · Private data: get_my_account, get_my_credits, get_generation · Public sink: get_my_account

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
